snippet.title: The Sinking City 2 - Welcome To Arkham | Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Coming August 18, 2026 on PC, PS5, and Xbox Series. Play Steam Demo now: https://link.frogwares.com/08af8e55 

Wishlist now on all platforms: https://link.frogwares.com/tsc2 

Welcome to the city of Arkham. Where the Cthulhu Mythos manifests. Where investigation is key to your survival. And when the Abyss awakens and eldritch beasts appear before you, rein in your fear. Or lose what is precious forever.

The Sinking City 2 is a survival horror set in a Lovecraftian vision of 1920s America, in the city of Arkham. As Calvin Rafferty, venture into the drowned streets of Arkham, pursued by eldritch horrors and the dead.
